description: Navigate live CWE parents, children, ancestors, or descendants for a weakness, category, grouping, or view. Discover IDs with cwe_search_weaknesses or cwe_list_reference topic views. The default view is 1000; set viewId all for every view. primaryOnly applies only to ancestors. Edges point from parent to child and retain view identity; follow nextCursor for more edges. Continuations re-fetch the traversal and reject changed topology. Empty relations are successful; upstream failures remain errors. Node names come from the loaded catalog and may lag live IDs.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation returned by this tool.

id.description: CWE ID such as CWE-79 or 79, for a weakness, category, grouping, or view.

limit.description: Maximum page size; capped at 100 and a 24,000-byte response budget with disclosure.

primaryOnly.description: Restrict ancestors to primary parents; invalid for other directions when true.

viewId.description: CWE view ID such as CWE-1000 or 1000, or all; discover with cwe_list_reference topic views. Blank means the default.

name: cwe_get_hierarchy

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `hierarchy_timeout`: The total hierarchy deadline expires during queue wait or an active traversal. `invalid_hierarchy_options`: viewId names no CWE view, or primaryOnly is true outside ancestors; the message names each. `hierarchy_unavailable`: The live response is inconsistent or a locally known root returns 404. `queue_full`: The live hierarchy service has no available request slot. `invalid_cursor`: Traversal, query, or catalog changed since the cursor was created. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Whether the root exists according to the live hierarchy response.

guidance.description: Recovery guidance for an unknown root.

hierarchyFingerprint.description: Full traversal and catalog version fingerprint.

nodes.description: Endpoint nodes of this page's edges; the first page also lists roots without edges.

items.description: Endpoint of an edge on this page, or a root without edges on the first page.

type.description: Upstream type. Roots the server adds (parents, single-view children, or an empty single-view result) use the catalog type, or unknown when unavailable.

notice.description: Paging cap or source drift notice.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation for the same normalized query.

retrievedAt.description: Live retrieval time in ISO format.

title: Get CWE hierarchy
